author: nonretail_writer
central_thesis: Markets at the 2023-11-14 cutoff price a finished Fed and a soft landing (20-observation bull flattening, VIX 14.76, tight credit), while the five-observation 2Y rebound after Powell's hawkish remarks, a weak 30-year auction, Moody's negative US outlook and a pending stopgap vote show the front end and term premium have not been settled; the October CPI print is the gate. Positioning: own quality growth with its own catalysts (AI semiconductors after the H200, megacap software, aerospace backlog) and investment-grade carry, keep duration as a hedge, stay underweight China beta, energy, materials and European autos while China's deflation and property rescue remain unresolved, and stay overweight Polish banks and domestic consumer leaders on a strong zloty and an orderly political handover, with the NBP governance conflict as the main divergence.
sources_policy: Facts come only from the frozen 2023-11-14 feed (via tools/digest.py) and the 2023-11-14 market card (via tools/showcard.py); no other date's feed, card, spec, draft or note and no web resource was used. Every citation is published before 2023-11-14T00:00Z within its window: company news and previews no older than seven days, company results no older than fourteen days, macro releases and policy baselines no older than thirty-five days. Previews are used only for pending events, never for outcomes. Numbers are quoted from the card (prices, 1/5/20-session changes, Treasury curve, 20- and 5-observation bps changes) or from a headline cited in the same part; no spot-FX levels or returns are used, and currency direction relies on dated headlines (zloty strength, weak yen). Polish-language headlines are translated in the PL block; Polish companies are kept out of the Sector Deep Dive.
